chunks: And indeed I will send them a gift, so I will see with what the envoers return.

key_terms.مُرْسِلَةٌ: I will send (feminine form, referring to Bilqis)

ai.seo_question: What was Queen Bilqis's strategy in sending a gift to Prophet Solomon?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Bilqis's diplomatic prudence as she seeks to distinguish Solomon’s prophetic humility from royal ambition through the reception of her gift. This strategic pause reflects the broader Quranic theme of testing spiritual integrity against worldly power, a motif resonant with the narrative of the Children of Israel. The act of sending the gift serves as a litmus test for Solomon’s detachment from material wealth, reinforcing his status as a divinely guided ruler.
